raw: [name="Typhon"]In their eyes, I am someone who's had her fate twisted. Like... branches that have been artificially grafted together.

content: In their eyes, I am someone who's had her fate twisted. Like... branches that have been artificially grafted together.

raw: [name="Typhon"]Trees like that will not grow properly.
speaker: Typhon
content: Trees like that will not grow properly.

raw: [name="Magallan"]But you seem perfectly fine to me!
speaker: Magallan
content: But you seem perfectly fine to me!

speaker: Typhon
content: Mhm. I think so too.

speaker: Magallan
content: Oh, Simone.

raw: [name="Santalla"]Please, let me check if you two are okay.
speaker: Santalla
content: Please, let me check if you two are okay.

raw: [name="Typhon"]This birdbrain over here seems fine enough. She just won't stop bouncing around.

content: This birdbrain over here seems fine enough. She just won't stop bouncing around.

speaker: Magallan
content: Ehh?

raw: [name="Typhon"]Do you disagree? You act as if nothing happened.

content: Do you disagree? You act as if nothing happened.

speaker: Magallan
content: Well, I guess that's true.

speaker: Typhon
content: Oh right, Simone.

speaker: Santalla
content: What is it?

raw: [name="Typhon"]I didn't have time to answer your question earlier. I'll do it now.
speaker: Typhon
content: I didn't have time to answer your question earlier. I'll do it now.

speaker: Typhon
content: —I am scared.

speaker: Santalla
content: ...Hmm.

raw: [name="Typhon"]But when I'm on the hunt, I have other things to think about.
speaker: Typhon
content: But when I'm on the hunt, I have other things to think about.

raw: [name="Typhon"]Where to aim. The speed of the wind. Deducing where my prey will be. When my head is full of these thoughts, I have no time to be scared.
speaker: Typhon
content: Where to aim. The speed of the wind. Deducing where my prey will be. When my head is full of these thoughts, I have no time to be scared.

raw: [name="Typhon"]I know that I must overcome, again and again. My resolve will never be shaken.
speaker: Typhon
content: I know that I must overcome, again and again. My resolve will never be shaken.

raw: [name="Typhon"]But just now, when the ice shattered, if I'd been the one to fall through, then that too would be fate's plan.
speaker: Typhon
content: But just now, when the ice shattered, if I'd been the one to fall through, then that too would be fate's plan.

raw: [name="Santalla"]So are you able to calmly confront the torments of fate... because Arges shared her visions with you?
speaker: Santalla
content: So are you able to calmly confront the torments of fate... because Arges shared her visions with you?

speaker: Typhon
content: No, she's never spoken of them.

raw: [name="Santalla"]Haha, that makes me feel better then. The tragic prophecies of a Cyclops should not befall a child like you.
speaker: Santalla
content: Haha, that makes me feel better then. The tragic prophecies of a Cyclops should not befall a child like you.

speaker: Santalla
content: Where's Gitano?

speaker: Magallan
content: She left by herself.

raw: [name="Magallan"]I don't know where she plans to go, but she said she'll send word to Rhodes Island once she's made up her mind.
speaker: Magallan
content: I don't know where she plans to go, but she said she'll send word to Rhodes Island once she's made up her mind.

raw: [name="Santalla"]...How unfortunate. There was something I wanted to tell her earlier.
speaker: Santalla
content: ...How unfortunate. There was something I wanted to tell her earlier.

raw: [name="Santalla"]But she should already understand by now.
speaker: Santalla
content: But she should already understand by now.

raw: [name="Magallan"]Oh right! Even though I don't know exactly what's going on, I need to thank you all for resolving the crisis! Gitano too!
speaker: Magallan
content: Oh right! Even though I don't know exactly what's going on, I need to thank you all for resolving the crisis! Gitano too!

speaker: Typhon
content: Wait, what did she do?

raw: [name="Typhon"]She was already exhausted by her Arts. And given the terror caused by the disaster, she wouldn't have been able to do anything rash.
speaker: Typhon
content: She was already exhausted by her Arts. And given the terror caused by the disaster, she wouldn't have been able to do anything rash.

speaker: Magallan
content: Oh, she sent a request for help to the nearby tribes yesterday.

raw: [name="Magallan"]Just earlier, she told me something in secret... that she felt a vague sense of worry and guilt, so she wanted to ask for help.
speaker: Magallan
content: Just earlier, she told me something in secret... that she felt a vague sense of worry and guilt, so she wanted to ask for help.

raw: [name="Magallan"]—Hello there, Mister Snowpriest! Thank you and the other Treescar warriors for helping us today!
speaker: Magallan
content: —Hello there, Mister Snowpriest! Thank you and the other Treescar warriors for helping us today!

speaker: Magallan
content: You're all lifesavers!

speaker: Eikthyrnir
content: Child of the Santalla tree, daughter born of the biting cold.

speaker: Santalla
content: Please do not call me that.

speaker: Eikthyrnir
content: You went after the Ursus.

speaker: Santalla
content: ...So you can see everything.

speaker: Eikthyrnir
content: How did it go?

speaker: Eikthyrnir
content: You once hesitated because you longed for the shade beneath the ancient branches, and failed to become a Snowpriest.

raw: [name="Eikthyrnir"]If you still wish to live as the old tree's steward, then I have no further questions for you.
speaker: Eikthyrnir
content: If you still wish to live as the old tree's steward, then I have no further questions for you.

raw: [name="Santalla"]My time is limited because of Oripathy.
speaker: Santalla
content: My time is limited because of Oripathy.

raw: [name="Eikthyrnir"]That is no reason for you to lose sight of your goals.
speaker: Eikthyrnir
content: That is no reason for you to lose sight of your goals.

raw: [name="Eikthyrnir"]You understand this well, daughter of the Santalla Tree.
speaker: Eikthyrnir
content: You understand this well, daughter of the Santalla Tree.

raw: [name="Eikthyrnir"]You understand the futility of revenge better than anyone else. It is precisely because of that futility that it becomes a never-ending task, one that requires a constant search for new lives to fulfill it.
speaker: Eikthyrnir
content: You understand the futility of revenge better than anyone else. It is precisely because of that futility that it becomes a never-ending task, one that requires a constant search for new lives to fulfill it.

raw: [name="Santalla"]I... am just an outcast. Hardly worthy of your attention.
speaker: Santalla
content: I... am just an outcast. Hardly worthy of your attention.

content: No one has forgotten the young shaman who was born to command the wind and snow.

content: Then I'm sure you're quite disappointed now that you've met her in person.

content: No.

content: She is a warrior, just as in the legends of the past.

content: 'Bjoda,' 'Andarsár.'

content: The will of the All-Father has warned us. All that you see serves as a warning.

content: The mountains raised by Sami are not enough to protect us from the disaster. Our sole enemy encroaches on our land.

content: Even so, will you continue to wander the icefield, aimlessly seeking vengeance?

content: I only had time to see the ruined end. Is this fate showing mercy, or cruelty?
